149.ultDialog: Your fate is in my hands!
149.atkDialog: Feel the power of the Ancient Sphere.
149.atk3Dialog: My curse gives me pain but also strength.
149.atk4Dialog: I place my curse upon you!

150.ReadyDialog: Shield not your eyes from the Light.
150.WalkDialog: The Divine Light shall illuminate your path.
150.CheerDialog: This is the Divine Light's grace.
150.atk2Dialog: If it's benediction you seek, listen close.
150.atk4Dialog: The Divine Light shines upon all.
150.IdleDialog: Oh Divine Light, my sole and eternal guide.

151.ReadyDialog: I'm here now. You may start cheering.
151.WalkDialog: I want to avoid getting dirty, if possible.
151.CheerDialog: Hmm... this victory might just make my autobiography.
151.atk3Dialog: Think you can take on the gods?!
151.atk4Dialog: This is the rhythm of battle.

152.ReadyDialog: Swordplay is a language that needs no translation.
152.WalkDialog: Esperia is a truly fascinating place.
152.ultDialog: Ten thousand miles I rode to war, through mountain peaks and valleys score.
152.atk2Dialog: Speed is the mother of victory.
152.atk3Dialog: Patience is what builds a warrior.
152.atk4Dialog: Don't mistake a temporary edge for a permanent advantage!

153.ReadyDialog: The Light is not omnipotent, but it will forever light my way.
153.WalkDialog: When I am lost, I look to answers from the Divine Light.
153.CheerDialog: I will always stand with hope!
153.atkDialog: Faith, not superstition. Follow, but don't follow blindly.
153.atk2Dialog: The Flame gives off Light, and Light ignites the Flame.
153.atk4Dialog: Together, the Divine Light and Flame illuminate the world.
153.IdleDialog: The Divine Flame is with me.

154.ReadyDialog: I'm no human! Could a human jump like this?
154.CheerDialog: See my ears? My parents made them just for me!
154.ultDialog: They say I don't look like my folks... but we're still family!
154.atk2Dialog: Hyah! How do you like that?
154.atk3Dialog: Encircling me? You've still got lots to learn.
154.atk4Dialog: Place nice! Cuz there's no escaping me!
154.IdleDialog: Look how high I can jump!
154.Idle2Dialog: Isn't my grappling hook so fun?

155.ReadyDialog: The world shall crumble in despair.
155.WalkDialog: I'll stop for nothing on my path of destruction!
155.CheerDialog: Victory can't mend a shattered dream.
155.ultDialog: These flames shall be your end!
155.atkDialog: Will you take this chance to run away?
155.atk2Dialog: The smoke of sin fills the air.
155.atk3Dialog: Fear me or not, your life is forfeit.
155.atk4Dialog: Let the nightmares tear your soul apart!

156.ReadyDialog: I have ruled before and I shall rule again.
156.ultDialog: Bantus shall be mine once again!
156.atkDialog: Some are too foolish for this mortal coil.
156.atk2Dialog: Oh how I have missed this power...
156.atk3Dialog: Whatever malice thou inflicts upon me shall be repaid threefold.
156.atk4Dialog: Kneel before me, and thou shall find salvation!

157.ReadyDialog: If it would save my people, let Esperia burn.
157.WalkDialog: You cannot be everyone's salvation, Talene.
157.CheerDialog: The Obsidian Finches shall be reborn!
157.ultDialog: The Obsidian Finches shall rise from your ashes!
157.atkDialog: They sacrificed a worthy few for the unworthy many.
157.atk2Dialog: The Gods disguise needless death as noble sacrifice.
157.atk4Dialog: You shall be the kindling of my people's rebirth!
157.IdleDialog: My people... We are coming home...
157.Idle2Dialog: Long burn the flames of calamity!

158.ReadyDialog: Guess there's no getting around this fight.
158.WalkDialog: Watch your step—footprints say a lot about you.
158.CheerDialog: And the world gains a few new headstones.
158.ultDialog: That was a huge mistake. You're my prey now.
158.atk2Dialog: This is the one thing I can't leave behind.

159.ReadyDialog: I'm Emilia, and this spirit here is Puck.
159.WalkDialog: Shall we go over there? Let's check it out!
159.atk2Dialog: Sorry, but I'll have to freeze you!

160.WalkDialog: Rem will always travel by your side!
160.ultDialog: I am Rem, a servant of Margrave Mathers.
160.atk2Dialog: You'll get no mercy from me!
160.atk3Dialog: I shall honor my duty as a servant.

161.ReadyDialog: One must be merciless in the pursuit of justice.
161.WalkDialog: My resolve is immutable: evil shall not be tolerated.
161.CheerDialog: The world shall be free of evil someday.
161.atkDialog: Compassion undeserved only begets more evil.

162.ultDialog: Listen to the beautiful clank of my hammer! Uh... I hope it won't break.
162.atkDialog: Cut the nonsense and fight me.
162.atk2Dialog: Do you want to be hit by a hammer or gun?
162.atk3Dialog: Harder, harder! Are you just scratching my itch or what?
162.atk4Dialog: Oh no. You can't collapse so easily, can you?

163.ReadyDialog: I long for the day when I can return to the mountain peaks once more.
163.WalkDialog: Mortals aren't without their own merits. After all, they invented ice cream.
163.CheerDialog: Bask in the joy of summer!
163.ultDialog: Summer brings both scorching heat and blissful shade.
163.atk2Dialog: May the scent of blooming flowers fill you with joy.
163.atk3Dialog: Monsoon season is upon us once more.

164.ReadyDialog: To gaze at the stars is to gaze at the secrets of fate and the universe.
164.WalkDialog: Traversing the cosmos is such a wonderful experience.
164.CheerDialog: Do not falter because of this. The universe still holds many untold secrets.
164.ultDialog: The light of the stars shall guide our path.
164.atkDialog: What shall fate decide this time?
164.atk3Dialog: As the stars rise and fall, so too does destiny.
164.atk4Dialog: The secrets of the universe serve to empower me.

165.ReadyDialog: Nothing is more divine than the taste of power.
165.CheerDialog: I am the unrivaled maestro in this power game.
165.ultDialog: Let this all-consuming power plunge the world into darkness!
165.atk2Dialog: To wear this crown is to bear its weight.
165.atk4Dialog: Thank me later, I grant you the power to defend yourself.
165.IdleDialog: You will all end up as my pawns.
165.Idle2Dialog: I can always catch things that are invisible to you.

166.WalkDialog: Where my strings reach, all must obey.
166.CheerDialog: Your remains may still be of use to me.
166.ultDialog: I shall make you dance once more.
166.atkDialog: You serve me little purpose while you still draw breath.
166.atk4Dialog: Heheheh... Come, take a closer look...

167.ReadyDialog: Fun desert games? I triumph in every single one!
167.WalkDialog: Mom and Dad will surely be surprised when they see me!
167.CheerDialog: Let me see what we have this time!
167.atkDialog: Yet another to play with me?
167.atk2Dialog: The sand is devouring your body. Behold...
167.atk3Dialog: Let's play a new game! One, two, three!
167.atk4Dialog: Nadia and I will protect each other.

168.CheerDialog: How disappointing... I hope the next toy doesn't break so easily.
168.ultDialog: Get in there and fight, or else you're next!
168.atkDialog: You lost, so now it's time for your punishment!
168.atk3Dialog: If you survive, it'll be your turn to look for me!
168.IdleDialog: Your turn now to be the toy!

169.WalkDialog: Pardon me, but have you seen Lucilla?
169.ultDialog: I must admit... Mischief can be quite fun.
169.atkDialog: I shouldn't enjoy this, but a bit of mischief is fine now and then.
169.atk2Dialog: Don't worry, you will feel better soon.
169.atk3Dialog: I'm sorry, but I had no other choice.
169.atk4Dialog: Without balance, the world will descend into chaos.

170.ReadyDialog: I will illuminate your path to victory.
170.ultDialog: All the stars responding to my call––let's defeat the darkness together!
170.atkDialog: This shot packs the power of the stars.
170.atk2Dialog: The Astral Soul will look after comrades who fight for justice.
170.atk3Dialog: Don't you dare hurt my friends.
170.atk4Dialog: The starlight will chase down every evil.
170.IdleDialog: If you lose light, I will be the Dawnbringer that brings you hope.

171.ReadyDialog: Who summons the Thousand Sail Fleet?
171.WalkDialog: And why, may I ask, must I deal with this riff-raff myself?
171.CheerDialog: Now you have seen the full force of the navy.
171.ultDialog: For the glory of the Thousand Sail Fleet, show me what you've got!
171.atkDialog: You'll make for an adequate warm-up.
171.atk3Dialog: Not bad! My fleet needs people like you!
171.atk4Dialog: Who said you could set foot on my deck?

172.ReadyDialog: My bow and arrows exist for justice and truth.
172.CheerDialog: What a sweeping victory, and bountiful spoils!
172.atkDialog: Can you run faster than my arrow?
172.atk2Dialog: Want to catch me? Haha, you're way too green for that.
172.atk3Dialog: We want justice and fairness, and money is just a means to that end.
172.atk4Dialog: Thank you for your hard work. I'll take these gold coins with me.

173.WalkDialog: You're not taking Daimon away from me!
173.atkDialog: Do you hear the mournful souls grieving…
173.atk2Dialog: Only revenge can appease the souls in pain.
173.atk3Dialog: I feel all of your pain.
173.atk4Dialog: It's not yet time to leave...

174.ReadyDialog: What sort of services do you require this time?
174.WalkDialog: The chimes persist wherever it reaches.
174.ultDialog: Come, all of you, and feel the nourishment of this lament.
174.atk3Dialog: This is no illusion, and I'm not hearing things.
174.atk4Dialog: Preach the doctrine to the world.

210.ReadyDialog: I take it you've finished with your preparations? All right. Then let the massacre begin.
210.WalkDialog: I may be a petite and beautiful little monster. But I'm also cold, cruel, and ruthless.
210.CheerDialog: You did very well to get this far.
210.ultDialog: I hope you will entertain me well.
210.atk2Dialog: Let's see how you handle my spellcraft!
210.atk3Dialog: I love watching you try to play tough.
210.atk4Dialog: Don't worry, I didn't cheat. That was another one of my special skills.

213.ReadyDialog: I won't cause you any trouble.
213.WalkDialog: Please don't make me go back to that scary place...
213.ultDialog: This power... It's a part of me now.

217.WalkDialog: The deeper you go, the more you'll need the power of a magician, right?
217.CheerDialog: Is anyone hurt? I'll heal you right away!
217.atkDialog: I hope you don't expect me to go easy on you!
217.atk3Dialog: I can understand this spell! I can overwrite it!

218.ReadyDialog: Oh, a monster! I wonder what kind of anatomy it has?
218.WalkDialog: Stay in formation! Don't let us get surrounded!
218.CheerDialog: Wow, this meat is surprisingly good quality! Would it be better in a soup or grilled, I wonder?
218.atk3Dialog: Fresh ingredients! I'm dying to try them!

224.WalkDialog: I'll keep getting stronger. Keep leveling up.
224.CheerDialog: What if I grew stronger after every battle?

225.ReadyDialog: Show me what you're really made of.
225.WalkDialog: I hope you'll stay with me until the end.
225.CheerDialog: My blade will lead us to victory.
225.atk2Dialog: Cut down everything in my way!
225.atk3Dialog: Your safety? I've got it covered.

227.ReadyDialog: Rod, bait... alright! Time to fish!
227.WalkDialog: Hear that? The fish are calling out to me.
227.ultDialog: Woah! We've got a big one on the line!
227.atk2Dialog: Good bait brings plenty of fish!
227.atk3Dialog: C'mon, let's stir up some waves!
227.atk4Dialog: Let's try out the new gear!

230.ReadyDialog: Night has fallen, and moonlight illuminates your path.
230.WalkDialog: Whether in joy or in sorrow, I will always stand by your side.
230.CheerDialog: I'm sure you'll have sweet dreams tonight!
230.ultDialog: The stars and moonlight glimmer, answering your prayers.
230.atkDialog: As the moonlight caresses the shadows.
230.atk2Dialog: Heed the meteor's warning and follow the path of the moon.
230.atk4Dialog: May you never fear the darkness of night.

236.ReadyDialog: I'm just a guy who's a hero for fun.
236.WalkDialog: I'm getting kind of fired up.
236.CheerDialog: Not again... All it took was one punch!
236.atk3Dialog: Killer Move: Serious Series. Serious Sideways Jumps!

237.ReadyDialog: Well now,doesn't that sound interesting. Want me to go?
237.WalkDialog: You'd better tell me if you find anything that looks like it can fight.
237.ultDialog: All of you would be dead without me. Can't you even finish one small fry?
237.atk4Dialog: All of you would be dead without me.

242.ReadyDialog: I'll forgive the intrusion. After all, dinner should serve itself.
242.WalkDialog: Mm, come closer... You smell like trouble.
242.CheerDialog: How disappointing... I thought you'd be better than that.
242.ultDialog: I'll grant you an endless night.
242.atk2Dialog: Dear, feel special. You're the one I selected.

247.ReadyDialog: As a good show should be.
247.WalkDialog: Not being controlled by strings... Have you forgotten the feeling, Punch?
247.CheerDialog: Now, every ovation is mine alone.
247.ultDialog: It's your time to take the spotlight, Punch.
247.atk2Dialog: Punch! Bring them to center stage.
247.atk3Dialog: The curtain of this stage will not fall so easily.
247.atk4Dialog: To be a proper puppet, you need to be more obedient.

251.ReadyDialog: By shield and spear, order shall rise anew.
251.WalkDialog: My shield and spear are never drawn for trifles.
251.ultDialog: In the name of Pallas, stand behind my shield and take shelter.
251.atk3Dialog: A blade honed too much exposes a flaw.
251.atk4Dialog: Where the sacred spear falls, every law is silenced.

252.ReadyDialog: Care to look into my eyes?
252.WalkDialog: Mind the statues. They, too, once claimed to be heroes.
252.CheerDialog: Even a gaze may serve as judgment.
252.ultDialog: All who meet my gaze shall harden into the shape of fear.
252.atk2Dialog: Let the illusion confess what you cannot.
252.atk3Dialog: Behold. Arrogance has finally taken form.
252.atk4Dialog: Run... Fear will coil around you in my place.

256.WalkDialog: I'm not going to lose. I'll take care of him.
256.CheerDialog: Let me take care of the rest!
256.ultDialog: Kafka Hibino... No. Kaiju No. 8. Joining the fight.
256.atkDialog: I'll fight with my own weapons!
256.atk2Dialog: Everyone else risked their lives during this fight! I can't be the only one who puts his own safety first!
256.atk4Dialog: I... I'm not Kaiju No. 8. I'm Kafka Hibino.

1126.ReadyDialog: I've got a nightmare just for you!
1126.CheerDialog: Indulging in a fine dream, or sinking into a nightmare, it's all the same!
1126.atk3Dialog: Mortal will is so easily crushed!
1126.atk4Dialog: The fear makes your dreams so much more enchanting!
1126.Idle2Dialog: Reality is even more sickening than a nightmare!
